announcements.headline: Notice of Half Year Results
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc announces half-year results. This follows the Australian partner progressing the Ox-1 Phase 1 trial in October.

announcements.headline: Ethics submission for Ox-1 Phase 1 study
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc submits ethics approval for the Ox-1 Phase 1 study, following the Australian partner's October announcement to progress this trial.

announcements.headline: Investor Conference Attendance
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc confirms attendance at an investor conference. This follows recent governance updates including a nominated adviser change and AGM results.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow the September notice. The recent change of nominated adviser may influence future governance.

announcements.headline: Change of Nominated Adviser
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc changes its nominated adviser. This follows the September capital raise and trial update, suggesting ongoing support for its development activities.

announcements.headline: Australian partner to progress Ox-1 Phase 1 trial
announcements.insight: The Australian partner progresses the Phase 1 trial. This follows the September investor presentation, indicating continued development activity.

announcements.headline: Posting of Annual Report and Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM notice follows the September results announcement. Shareholders should monitor the meeting outcomes for any further capital actions.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results and Investor Presentation
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc announces results following its August capital raise and September general meeting. Shareholders should watch for details on how these funds are deployed.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The general meeting results follow the August capital raise announcement. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on how the raised funds are deployed.

announcements.headline: Proposed Placing & Subscription to raise £1.05m
announcements.insight: TheraCryf Plc is raising £1.05m via a placing and subscription. This capital raise represents a significant funding event for the company.
